statement: The well keeps failing because stone cannot hold in the moving clay bank: its lining has cracked and been mended every year, and the ford seeps in through the new crack.
Clay, the landing's own craft, would hold the well where stone cracks, so the landing could mend it without building in stone.
The landing's charge was set in answer to the station's rise, and the two together are driving travellers to wade at the crocodile's pool at night.
Something in the spring, not the food, is making people sick.
The courier did not leave; he was murdered and hidden in the spring.
The attackers came for the courier's satchel and for the cutting, not for the gang.
The clutch died because the cutting's roots were cut, not because the cutting withdrew.
The attack was one cell, led by the woman with the cord, that came for the satchel and for the cutting's sap, with jars ready.
With the roll burnt, the broker's whole claim rests on the survivors' word, and a release he speaks before witnesses would end it.
The root was cut by two strangers who came by the north reeds and used the unbarred workshop: the tree closed through a cut, not through Pays-Late's keeping.
The leeches are an effect of the spilled sap, not the cause of the closing.
Pays-Late hid the cut and washes it out of fear, not guilt.
The two parties are each half right, and the difference between a Hist turning and a Hist cut is the player's to carry.
The salt works are not the cause.
The salt comes up from a breach below the village.
The founders cut the breach to kill a rival grove.
